name: 同時に一つ選ぶセグメント切替
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create candidate LH07-0025 v005 in response to the owner's sizing feedback. The attached v001 feels too big and spacious; the latest compact revision v004 still feels too compact. Make a clearly visible middle size.

Reference order:
Image 1 is the original source screenshot. It controls the segmented control's anatomy, equal division, outline, and alignment.
Image 2 is the Japanese component preview. It controls exact wording, order, and center-selected state.
Image 3 is v001, the exact image the owner attached. Use it as the main visual edit target, but reduce its control size moderately.
Image 4 is v004, a too-compact recent candidate. Use it only to confirm the clean styling and green treatment; do not copy its small size.
Image 5 is the approved Lighthouse style reference. Use it only for the restrained white surface and forest-green gradient.

Keep the same clean 3:1 white composition. In a 390×130 logical canvas, center one 300×40 segmented control (about 77% of the canvas width and 31% of its height). This sits between the attached wide v001 and compact v004. The outer control has three equal cells, each about 100×40, with balanced 32px side space around a three-character label and 12px above and below the 16px text line. Do not reduce the text size. Give the canvas balanced margins; avoid the nearly full-width appearance of v001 and the narrow, short appearance of v004.

Preserve exactly these labels, left to right: 小さめ, 標準, 大きめ. Only the middle 標準 segment is selected. Use the established Meiryo Regular 400, 12px, 16px line height, no bold, no added letter spacing. Unselected text is slate #526173 on white. The selected center has white text over the smooth forest-green gradient #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E, with a small even inset from its cell edges. Keep the fine neutral outer outline, subtle dividers, even label alignment, and moderate rounded corners. Use no shadow or a very subtle neutral shadow.

No heading, icons, checkmarks, duplicate controls, extra cards, phone frame, other settings, or decorative effects. Keep all three options equally prominent except for the selected center. Orthographic clean UI render, no watermark.
reviewNotes: Candidate-only v005. At displayed size the control is still about 58% of canvas width and 22% of canvas height, visually close to compact v003/v004 instead of the requested middle size. Next pass will use v001 as the only generated-candidate reference. No owner approval, native editability, application implementation, or runtime acceptance claimed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.observations: Original reference for equal three-segment anatomy and source geometry.
Exact Japanese content and selected middle state.
Exact local file matching the user attachment by SHA-256; visually too large/spacious, use as main edit target and reduce moderately.
Latest registered revision; actual-size display still too compact, use only as clean styling reference.
